description: List the workspace's current connections with their source restrictions and freshness. Use it to see what is already connected before planning a new one. Returns connection metadata and a continuation cursor; never secrets, and it grants no source access.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this caller and inventory revision; refresh if the inventory changes.

limit.description: Maximum connections in one page; defaults to 25, capped at 100.

q.description: Case-insensitive connection name or service search; up to 200 characters.

source.description: Filter by canonical store; direct metadata still requires admin role and scope.

name: connections_list
